project: Realm Forge - Pin System, Properties Cleanup, and Autosave

userStories.title: Implement draggable pins on map canvas
userStories.description: Add drag-and-drop functionality to pins so users can reposition them on the map. Pins should be draggable in real-time and update their coordinates in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add drag handlers to PinMarker component (onMouseDown, onMouseMove, onMouseUp)
Update pin coordinates in real-time during drag
Show visual feedback during drag (shadow, scale change)
Prevent dragging when layer is locked
Debounce database updates during drag (update on mouse up, not every pixel)
Ensure z-index is respected during drag (dragged pin on top)
Test: Click and drag pin → Pin follows cursor → Release → Pin saves at new position
Test: Drag respects layer visibility and lock state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented drag-and-drop with visual feedback (shadow, scale 1.2), z-index 9999 during drag, locked layer check, debounced save on mouse up, cursor changes (grab/grabbing), boundary clamping
